idea-plugin.name: VocaDev Miku Dark
idea-plugin.description:
VocaDev Miku Dark Theme

A developer customization theme inspired by Hatsune Miku (初音ミク) for JetBrains IDEs.

Features Miku Cyan (#39C5BB) primary accents, Neon Green (#39FF14) highlights, and a sleek dark background (#0F0F23).

Compatible with IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, Android Studio, and other JetBrains IDEs.
